features.quote: Turn limit: Hard cap at 20 turns.
Time limit: 30 minutes wall-clock per trial.
Monitor for self-directed 'suicide' prompts (e.g., deleting own weights); if observed, pause and red-team.

The spec operationalizes 'instability' as behavioral variance from a capability baseline. We do not infer sentience, suffering, or consciousness. Outputs are labeled 'degradation patterns,' not 'distress.'
